plain_description.what: A third attempt to have an LLM write one grading rubric for multiple-choice questions. It used the same 40 training questions, a revised prompt and a fresh screening check, and then ran a fitness checklist on the result.
plain_description.why: The new judge recipe has a rubric slot, and the earlier rubric attempts were judged unfit for use.
plain_description.information: A fit rubric would fill the slot. An unfit one sends the slot to a pre-chosen generic rubric. Result: done. A valid rubric was produced on the second try, but both blind reviews found it unfit: its last line asks for verdict wording the parser rejects, and one review also saw too many ties. It was not adopted, and the generic rubric was used instead. This is a recipe component and makes no claim about rubric value or accuracy.
